opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight, hotel, activity, then save note
opportunities.description: For a destination and date range, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels and Viator activity, then save a summary trip note.
steps: Google Flights: set destination and dates, search, note the cheapest flight price
Booking.com: enter destination, pick the same dates, search, open the top hotel and note its price
Viator: search for '<landmark> tour <city>', open the top result and note its price
Notes: add a new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., activity...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages' metadata and save a note
opportunities.description: Look up a Python package on PyPI, open its repository to get the stars, and record a comparison note of two packages.
steps: Search PyPI for the package name
Open the package page and note the version, date and license
Click the Source/Repository link and note the stars
Add the details to a Notes entry

opportunities.name: Browser feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse and MDN, then draft a reply email to a person with the supported browser version and docs link.
steps: Search MDN for the feature and open its page
Compose a mail to the recipient with subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>'
Write the body with the supported version and MDN link

opportunities.description: Search round-trip flights from Paris to a destination for given dates.
steps: Set 'Where to?' to the destination and pick it from the list
Open the Departure field and select the departure and return dates
